info.title: NCBI Entrez E-utilities API
info.description: The Entrez Programming Utilities (E-utilities) provide a stable interface to the NCBI Entrez query and database system. Nine server-side programs allow searching, fetching, posting, linking, and summarizing records across PubMed and 38 NCBI databases including PubMed Central, Gene, Nuccore, and Protein. Supports searching 35M+ biomedical citations, retrieving abstracts, full-text links, MeSH terms, and related article metadata.

get.description: Performs a text query search in a single Entrez database and retrieves a list of matching UIDs (unique identifiers). Results can be stored on the Entrez History server for later use with other E-utilities.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Database to search. Common values: pubmed, pmc, gene, nucleotide, protein, assembly, biosample.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Entrez text query (URL encoded). Spaces may be replaced by '+' signs. Can include field tags like [Author] or [MeSH Terms].

parameters.name: retstart
parameters.description: Sequential index of the first UID in the retrieved set (default: 0).

parameters.name: retmax
parameters.description: Total number of UIDs to retrieve (default: 20, max: 100000).

parameters.name: rettype
parameters.description: Retrieval type. Values: uilist (default), count.

parameters.name: retmode
parameters.description: Response format. Values: xml (default), json.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for results.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Limit search to specified field (e.g., Author, Title, MeSH Terms).

parameters.name: datetype
parameters.description: Type of date to limit the search. Values: mdat (modification date), pdat (publication date), edat (Entrez date).

parameters.name: reldate
parameters.description: Limit results to items published in the last n days.

parameters.name: mindate
parameters.description: Minimum date for date range filter (YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY/MM, or YYYY).

parameters.name: maxdate
parameters.description: Maximum date for date range filter (YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY/MM, or YYYY).

parameters.name: usehistory
parameters.description: Set to 'y' to store results on the Entrez History server for use in subsequent calls.

parameters.name: WebEnv
parameters.description: Web environment string returned from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

parameters.name: query_key
parameters.description: Integer query key returned by a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call (no spaces). Recommended.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address. Recommended for NCBI to contact in case of problems.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable up to 10 requests/second (vs 3 req/s without key).

get.description: Retrieves full records in a specified format for a list of input UIDs from an Entrez database. Supports multiple return types and modes depending on the target database.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Database from which to retrieve records (e.g., pubmed, nucleotide, protein, gene).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of UIDs to retrieve.

parameters.name: retstart
parameters.description: Sequential index of the first record to retrieve (default: 0).

parameters.name: retmax
parameters.description: Number of records to retrieve (default: 20, max: 10000).

parameters.name: rettype
parameters.description: Retrieval type. For PubMed: abstract, medline, uilist, docsum. For sequences: fasta, gb, gp.

parameters.name: retmode
parameters.description: Retrieval mode. Values: xml, text, asn.1.

parameters.name: WebEnv
parameters.description: Web environment string from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

parameters.name: query_key
parameters.description: Integer query key from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call (no spaces). Recommended.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address. Recommended.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable up to 10 requests/second.

200.description: Full records in the requested format

get.description: Returns document summaries (DocSums) for a list of input UIDs or for a set of UIDs stored on the Entrez History server.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Database containing the UIDs (e.g., pubmed, gene, assembly).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of UIDs.

parameters.name: retstart
parameters.description: Sequential index of first DocSum to retrieve (default: 1).

parameters.name: retmax
parameters.description: Number of DocSums to retrieve (max: 10000).

parameters.name: retmode
parameters.description: Response format. Values: xml (default), json.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Set to '2.0' to use version 2.0 ESummary XML with database-specific fields.

parameters.name: WebEnv
parameters.description: Web environment string from a previous ESearch, EPost, or ELink call.

parameters.name: query_key
parameters.description: Integer query key from a previous call.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

get.description: Returns UIDs linked to an input set of UIDs in either the same database or a different Entrez database. Also returns LinkOut URLs for non-Entrez external resources, and checks for the existence of links in either direction.

parameters.name: dbfrom
parameters.description: Database containing the input UIDs.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Database to search for linked records. Omit when cmd is llinks or llinkslib.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of UIDs.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: ELink command mode.

parameters.name: linkname
parameters.description: Name of a specific link to retrieve (e.g., pubmed_pubmed, pubmed_pmc).

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Entrez query to filter linked UIDs.

parameters.name: retmode
parameters.description: Response format (xml or json).

parameters.name: holding
parameters.description: Name of a LinkOut provider to restrict LinkOut links.

parameters.name: datetype
parameters.description: Type of date to limit the link results.

parameters.name: reldate
parameters.description: Limit results to items published in the last n days.

parameters.name: mindate
parameters.description: Minimum date for date range filter.

parameters.name: maxdate
parameters.description: Maximum date for date range filter.

parameters.name: WebEnv
parameters.description: Web environment string from a previous call.

parameters.name: query_key
parameters.description: Integer query key from a previous call.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

post.summary: EPost - Upload UIDs to History server
post.description: Accepts a list of UIDs from a given database and stores them on the Entrez History server. The stored set can then be used by subsequent ESearch, ESummary, EFetch, or ELink calls.

WebEnv.description: Existing web environment to append UIDs to.

tool.description: Name of application making the call.

api_key.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

200.description: WebEnv and query_key for use in subsequent calls

get.description: Provides a list of all valid Entrez databases, or information about a single database including field names, index terms, links to other Entrez databases, and other metadata.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Target database. Omit to return a list of all valid Entrez databases.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Set to '2.0' for EInfo XML version 2.0 with additional field attributes.

parameters.name: retmode
parameters.description: Response format. Values: xml (default), json.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

200.description: Database information or list of databases

get.description: Retrieves spelling suggestions for search terms in a given Entrez database.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Database to check spelling suggestions against.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Search term to check for spelling suggestions (URL encoded).

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

get.summary: EGQuery - Global search across all databases
get.description: Performs a text query in all Entrez databases simultaneously and returns the number of results for the query in each database.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Entrez search query (URL encoded).

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

200.description: Result counts across all Entrez databases

get.summary: ECitMatch - Match citations to PubMed IDs
get.description: Retrieves PubMed IDs (PMIDs) that correspond to a set of input citation strings. Each citation string must include journal, year, volume, page, author name, and a user-assigned key.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Only 'pubmed' is supported.

parameters.name: bdata
parameters.description: Citation strings formatted as: journal|year|volume|page|author|key|, separated by %0D (encoded newlines).

parameters.name: retmode
parameters.description: Response format (xml).

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Name of application making the call.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Contact email address.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

count.description: Total number of records matching the query.

retmax.description: Number of UIDs returned in this response.

retstart.description: Index of the first UID returned.

querykey.description: Integer query key assigned on the History server.

webenv.description: Web environment string for History server.

idlist.description: List of UIDs matching the query.

EFetchResult.description: Full records returned by EFetch. Structure varies by database and rettype/retmode.

result.description: Object with UIDs as keys and document summaries as values.

uids.description: List of UIDs in the result set.

querykey.description: Integer query key for the uploaded UIDs.

webenv.description: Web environment string for History server.

dblist.description: List of all valid Entrez databases (when no db parameter).

dbinfo.description: Detailed database information when db parameter is supplied.

ApiKeyAuth.name: api_key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Optional NCBI API key. Without a key: 3 requests/second. With a key: 10 requests/second. Register at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account/
